internal.title: SoundWave Bar 300 & BrewMaster: Common How-To Tickets
internal.body:
Three recurring issues drive this category:

1. Subwoofer compatibility (SoundWave Bar 300): Customers ask which subwoofers are compatible, often in a "thank you" email. Root cause: compatibility info is not surfaced in-box or in app. Confirm compatible subwoofer model list from product spec sheet and share directly. Note: one ticket referenced a subwoofer question for "AeroSnap X200 Camera" — this is customer confusion/copy-paste error, not a real compatibility issue. Verify product model before responding.

2. HDMI ARC setup (SoundWave Bar 300): Customers can't locate the ARC settings menu. Root cause: menu location isn't intuitive and manual instructions are unclear. Walk customer through Settings > Audio Output > HDMI ARC (confirm exact path with current firmware version). If firmware is outdated, advise update first.

3. Descaling light stays on (BrewMaster): Persists after running descale cycle twice. Root cause is usually one of: wrong descaling solution used, cycle not run to completion, or light needs manual reset via button hold after cycle. Ask which solution was used and confirm full cycle completion before escalating. Escalate to hardware team only if light persists after manual reset with correct solution — may indicate faulty sensor.

Consider updating onboarding materials/app to surface subwoofer compatibility and ARC steps proactively.

customer.title: Quick Answers: Soundbar Setup and Coffee Machine Descaling
customer.body:
Here are answers to our most common questions:

Which subwoofers work with my soundbar?
1. Check the compatible subwoofer list included in your product manual or on our website's product page.
2. Only subwoofers listed for your exact model are guaranteed to pair correctly.

How do I connect my soundbar via HDMI ARC?
1. Connect the HDMI cable to the ARC-labeled port on your TV and soundbar.
2. On your TV, open Settings, then Audio Output, then select HDMI ARC.
3. On your soundbar, select the HDMI input source.
4. If you don't see this option, update your TV's software and try again.

Why won't my descaling light turn off?
1. Make sure you're using the descaling solution recommended for your machine.
2. Run the full descaling program without pausing or turning off the machine.
3. After the cycle finishes, press and hold the descale button for 3 seconds to reset the light.
4. Still on? Contact us and we'll help further.

We're happy to help if these steps don't solve it.

internal.title: Common Product Defect Patterns: Brewers, Vacuums, Cameras, TVs
internal.body:
Four recurring defect clusters are generating repeat tickets. Use these notes before opening a new investigation.

1. BrewMaster water leak: Reported after ~6 months of use, puddle under unit during brew cycle. Likely worn internal seal or gasket. Confirm serial number, check warranty status, offer repair or replacement if under warranty.

2. CycloneVac V8 suction loss after ~10 minutes: Customers have already cleaned filters per manual. Likely clogged internal airway or failing motor seal, not filter-related. Escalate to hardware team if filter cleaning and hose check do not resolve.

3. AeroSnap X200 battery drain: Multiple reports of battery dying despite high indicator reading or full charge, even with camera off and firmware updated. This is a known issue under investigation (battery calibration/firmware). Do not send generic troubleshooting checklists — customers have already tried them. Log serial/order number and escalate to hardware/firmware team.

4. Lumina 43 LED dead pixels / backlight bleeding: Consistently reported in top-right corner on bright scenes, within two weeks of delivery. Confirmed manufacturing defect on this batch. Approve exchange directly if within 30 days; no further diagnostics needed.

For all cases, collect serial or order number and offer replacement/repair per warranty policy rather than repeated troubleshooting.

customer.title: What To Do If Your Product Isn't Working Right
customer.body:
We're sorry your product isn't performing as expected. Please try the steps below based on your issue:

1. Water leaking from your coffee maker: Make sure the water tank is seated correctly and not overfilled. If leaking continues, contact support with your serial number for a repair or replacement.

2. Vacuum losing suction: Check that all filters and hoses are fully clean and clear of blockages. If suction still drops after about 10 minutes, contact support with your serial number.

3. Camera battery draining quickly: Make sure your firmware is up to date. If the battery still drains overnight or shows much less life than expected, this may be a hardware issue — contact support with your order number.

4. TV screen showing dead pixels or backlight bleeding: If you notice this within a few weeks of delivery, contact support with your order number to request an exchange.

In all cases, please have your serial number or order number ready so we can help you quickly.

internal.title: Billing: Duplicate Charges and Delayed Post-Return Refunds
internal.body:
Two recurring issues drive most Billing tickets:

1. Duplicate charge on order. Customer sees two identical debits for one order. Root cause is a duplicate authorization/capture on the account or order, typically from a retried payment or gateway glitch. Verify by pulling the order's payment log and confirming two identical captures. If confirmed, refund the duplicate charge immediately and note the transaction ID reversed. No further customer action needed.

2. Refund delayed after return. Customer returned an item, return was confirmed received, but no refund appears after ~15 days. Check the returns system for confirmed receipt date and refund processing status. Most delays are due to refund batch processing lag or the refund being queued but not yet released. If receipt is confirmed but refund not initiated, manually trigger the refund and inform the customer of the standard processing window.

Escalate to Billing Ops if: duplicate charge appears more than once for the same customer/order, refund has been delayed beyond 20 days, or payment logs show a discrepancy you cannot resolve (e.g., only one capture but customer statement shows two).

Known issue: intermittent duplicate captures from payment gateway retries — flagged with Payments team, no ETA yet. Always confirm and refund on sight; do not ask customer to wait for a fix.

customer.title: What to Do About Duplicate Charges or a Missing Refund
customer.body:
If you were charged twice for one order:
1. Check your bank or card statement to confirm two identical charges for the same order number.
2. Contact us with your order number and the dates of both charges.
3. We will verify the duplicate and refund the extra charge to your original payment method. This typically appears within 5-10 business days, depending on your bank.

If you returned an item and haven't received your refund:
1. Confirm your return was marked as received (check your return confirmation email or tracking).
2. If it has been more than 14 days since confirmed receipt, contact us with your order number and return confirmation date.
3. We will check the status and process your refund right away if it hasn't already started.

In both cases, please have your order number ready when you reach out — this helps us resolve things faster. We're sorry for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while we get this sorted for you.

internal.title: Rotterdam Warehouse Delays and Refund Delays - Troubleshooting Guide
internal.body:
Pattern: Majority of tickets in this category involve orders stuck at the Rotterdam distribution centre for 15-19+ days, past the promised 3-5 business day window. A smaller cluster involves refunds not processing after a confirmed return receipt.

Root causes observed:
1. Package stuck at warehouse (most common) - outbound scan not occurring after inbound receipt, likely a backlog or system sync issue at Rotterdam.
2. Delivery date repeatedly postponed - linked to same warehouse backlog; app auto-updates ETA without customer notification.
3. Refund not processed after return - return confirmed received but refund not triggered in finance system.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. Pull order number and check internal warehouse dashboard for last scan location/date.
2. If order has been at Rotterdam over 5 business days past promise date, flag as warehouse backlog - do not promise new ship date without confirming with logistics team.
3. For refund cases, verify return receipt timestamp in returns system; if over 10 business days with no refund initiated, escalate to Finance.
4. Offer proactive compensation (discount/expedited shipping) per current policy for delays over 14 days.

Known issue: Ongoing Rotterdam backlog affecting multiple orders (ref: LOG-2026-Rotterdam). Escalate any new case matching this pattern to Logistics Ops lead rather than opening individual investigations. For refund delays exceeding 15 days, escalate directly to Finance, do not just reassure customer.

customer.title: What to Do If Your Order Is Delayed or Your Refund Hasn't Arrived
customer.body:
We're sorry your order or refund is taking longer than expected. Here's how to check on it:

1. Locate your order number (format ORD-2026-XXXXX) from your confirmation email.
2. Check your tracking link to see the last known location and date of your package.
3. If tracking shows your package has not moved for more than 5 business days, this usually means it's delayed at a distribution centre. We're aware of ongoing delays at our Rotterdam facility and are working to resolve them.
4. If it has been more than 3 weeks since you ordered, contact our support team with your order number so we can check the latest status and, where appropriate, offer compensation for the delay.
5. If you returned an item and it has been more than 10 business days since it was marked as received, contact support with your order number so we can look into your refund directly.

We appreciate your patience and are working to get things moving as quickly as possible.

internal.title: FrostCore Fridge-Freezer: Fridge Compartment Cooling Failure Within Warranty
internal.body:
Pattern: Multiple reports of FrostCore fridge-freezers losing cooling in the fridge compartment only (freezer unaffected), typically around 12-14 months of use, well within the 2-year warranty period.

Likely root cause: Known issue with fridge-side cooling component (evaporator/damper/sensor fault) that does not affect the freezer circuit. Treat as a recurring hardware defect pattern, not user error.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. Confirm serial number and purchase date to verify warranty status (should be under 24 months).
2. Ask customer to confirm freezer still runs normally and check door seals aren't the cause (rule out obvious user-fixable issues).
3. Confirm no error codes displayed, if applicable.
4. If freezer works but fridge does not, and unit is within warranty, this matches the known issue pattern — do not attempt lengthy remote diagnostics.

Resolution: Approve warranty repair/replacement directly. No further troubleshooting needed if pattern matches (14-month timeframe, fridge-only failure).

Escalation: Escalate to Product Quality team if serial number is not yet logged against this known issue, so it can be tracked. No need to escalate for standard repair approval — agents can process directly.

customer.title: FrostCore Fridge Not Cooling? Here's What To Do
customer.body:
If your FrostCore fridge-freezer has stopped cooling in the fridge section but the freezer is still working, don't worry — this is a known issue and is covered under your 2-year warranty.

Here's how to get it fixed:

1. Find your serial number (usually on a sticker inside the unit or on the back).
2. Check your purchase date to confirm you're within the 2-year warranty window.
3. Make sure the fridge door is closing fully and nothing is blocking the seal.
4. Contact our support team with your serial number, purchase date, and a brief description of the issue.
5. We'll arrange a repair or replacement at no cost to you.

You don't need to run any additional tests — if the fridge has stopped cooling while the freezer still works, our team can move straight to arranging your repair once your warranty is confirmed.

internal.title: Lumina OLED Firmware 3.2 Known Issue: Freezing, Reboots, Boot Failure
internal.body:
Known issue: Firmware/software update 3.2 for Lumina OLED (all sizes) causes screen freezing, constant reboots, or boot failure (stuck on logo/home screen). This is confirmed and widespread — do not treat as isolated hardware failure.

Symptoms reported: freezing within minutes of power-on, repeated reboots on home screen, stuck on startup logo, factory reset does not resolve.

Troubleshooting steps:
1. Confirm firmware version and serial number.
2. Advise standard power cycle (unplug 10 min) — note this often does NOT resolve it; set expectations accordingly.
3. Check if a rollback/downgrade path to prior firmware is available via engineering-approved USB recovery tool; if yes, walk customer through it.
4. If no rollback available, escalate to Tier 2/Engineering — do not promise replacement without escalation approval.
5. Log serial number and firmware version in ticket for tracking volume of affected units.

Escalation criteria: Any Lumina OLED case referencing update 3.2 symptoms should be flagged to the Firmware 3.2 issue tracker immediately. Do not close as resolved unless rollback/fix confirmed working.

Also note: unrelated Bluetooth pairing issue (AeroSnap Mini) — separate root cause, treat as standard connectivity troubleshooting (see connectivity KB).

customer.title: Lumina OLED TV Freezing or Stuck on Logo After Update 3.2
customer.body:
We're aware that software update 3.2 is causing some Lumina OLED TVs to freeze, reboot repeatedly, or get stuck on the startup logo. We're sorry for the inconvenience and are actively working on a fix.

While we finalize a permanent solution, please try these steps:

1. Unplug your TV from power for at least 10 minutes, then plug it back in.
2. If the TV still freezes or won't move past the logo screen, try a factory reset from the settings menu (if you can access it).
3. If the issue continues, please contact our support team with your TV's serial number so we can help you further, including checking whether a firmware rollback is available for your unit.

We appreciate your patience while we resolve this. You will not be left without support — our team can arrange further assistance or replacement options if needed once your case is reviewed.
